caption: The drawing depicts a single mechanical object resembling a vintage water pump or hydrant mounted on a rectangular wooden base. The main structure is predominantly green with yellowish or gold accent details along the edges and on some rounded decorative panels. The pump has a rectangular shaft with a slightly sloped, pyramid-shaped top which is surmounted by a spherical knob. From the upper part of the shaft extends a brown curved handle towards the right. A twisted metallic chain is attached near the spout, which protrudes horizontally from the front of the main shaft. Additionally, there is a wedge-shaped object, also green with some gray tones, positioned flat on the wooden base to the left of the pump. The wooden base is rectangular with visible wood grain texture and is reddish-brown in color. The background is plain and light, providing contrast to the objects. The artist's signature “A. Maralian” is visible in the lower left corner.
title: Toy Pump
